# Legacy compaction fixtures

These files were generated by SDK v0.30.1 commit
`bba86699c59a733974cfbf16b6e3a3cacfa01256`, before compaction provenance
moved from the token to the stats sidecar. They contain synthetic records.

- `old-fold.c1z`: a full sync folded with one partial by the old SDK.
  Its sidecar has 90,000 ms of grant-listing time; its token has the
  accumulated 95,000 ms. Compaction provenance exists only in the token.
- `old-partial.c1z`: another partial with 3,000 ms of grant-listing time.
- `metadata.json`: the writer commit and generated sync IDs.

`TestCompactPebbleFoldLegacyProvenance` opens these files with the current
SDK, folds them, and reopens the output. It checks timing and call totals,
provenance ancestry, record counts, removal of the old compaction section,
and a second fold that must prefer the new sidecar over the inherited token.
Before the fix, the first fold reports 93,000 ms instead of 98,000 ms.

To regenerate, check out the writer commit in a separate worktree, copy
`generate_test.go.txt` to `pkg/synccompactor/legacy_fixture_generate_test.go`,
create `/tmp/ledger-legacy-fixtures`, and run:

```sh
go test ./pkg/synccompactor -run '^TestGenerateLegacyFixtures$' -count=1
```

Copy the two `.c1z` files and `metadata.json` from
`/tmp/ledger-legacy-fixtures` into this directory. IDs and timestamps vary
between generations; the test reads IDs from the metadata file.
